title: Appendix: Release Refund Terms of the Homesite Reservation by Premium Class
content:
Appendix to the Homesite Reservation Agreement setting out, for each premium class, the refund terms that apply when the buyer releases a reservation.

| Premium class | Full-refund window (calendar days) | Premium holding fee refunded on a release inside the window | Percent of the premium holding fee refunded on a release after the window | Business days within which a refund is issued | Refund method |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 7 | Yes | 0 | 10 | original method |
| Corner Homesite | 7 | Yes | 0 | 10 | original method |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 5 | Yes | 50 | 10 | original method |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 5 | Yes | 50 | 10 | original method |
| Water-View Homesite | 3 | Yes | 25 | 10 | original method |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 3 | Yes | 0 | 10 | check |

## Definitions used in this appendix

- **Full-refund window**: the number of calendar days within which a buyer release refunds the premium holding fee in full.
- **Refunded inside the window**: whether the premium holding fee is refunded on a release inside the full-refund window.
- **Percent after the window**: the percent of the premium holding fee refunded on a release after the full-refund window.
- **Business days**: Monday to Friday, excluding Calloway holidays, within which a refund is issued after the release, expiry or withdrawal.
- **Refund method**: "original method" returns each refund to the account or card the payment came from; "check" returns refunds as a Calloway check.
